money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The local coin currency is the Panama Balboa (PAB). The banknote currency is the US Dollar (USD). Beware of counterfeit currency, especially USD50 and USD100 notes. You can't exchange Australian dollars in Panama, but you can exchange US dollars. Credit cards are widely accepted. Carry cash if you're travelling to rural areas. Most international hotels and tourist facilities accept credit and debit cards. Ask your bank whether your ATM card will work in Panama.

drone-pilot-pathway.summary: Panama's Civil Aeronautics Authority (AAC) registers drones and licenses pilots; commercial users should hold the operation licence and send a special-operations form request. No public operator register was found.

items.text: No public list of licensed drone pilots or operators was found on the AAC drone page or its procedure document.

The AAC's procedure document says to read Resolution 0004 (the RPAS Aeronautical Norm), apply in writing to the Director of Air Safety for a pilot licence (after a course and certificate) and drone registration, and that the operation licence matters most for commercial use. After licence and registration, the operator emails the AAC drone team about the purpose of the flight to receive the Special Operations Form. Approval takes at least five business days.
Not yet checked: the procedure document does not mention foreign visitors; it is addressed to people applying at the AAC offices.

Flights around the Cinta Costera, Avenida Balboa, Calle 50 and nearby need notice to the Institutional Protection Service (SPI); flights over Casco Antiguo need a note to the SPI or the Police Director, copied to the heritage directorate. Use WGS 84 coordinates and altitudes in feet above mean sea level.
